What they did

Help me build a job application assistant in this folder. Start with my resume at [resume file path] and a list of roles I want: [target job titles and companies]. For each posting I paste in, tailor my resume bullets and write a short cover note, saving both as files. Stop once it works on two sample postings, and never submit an application without showing me the final materials first.
